Develop the C3 Auth Module: password hashing, 60-minute JWT issue and verification (I3), user lookup over I13, and role checks for the four roles.
Develop the C2 Backend API skeleton, the OpenAPI contract for I2, and the database access layer for I7.
Develop the C4 Data Ingestion upload path: header and row validation, transactional import into C5 (I5, I6), and the rejected-row validation report.
Develop the C1 Web Dashboard shell: sign-in page, navigation, department filter, and current-operations views over I1 and I2.

Develop the C6 Forecasting Service: 7-day admission and bed occupancy models, the baseline, and the ForecastRun states QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED (I8, I10, I11).
Develop the C7 Planning & Alerts rules that compare forecasts with capacity settings and staffing ratios and write flags to C5 (I9, I12).
Develop the C1 Web Dashboard forecast, alert, and upload pages with Plotly charts, the 90% threshold line, and data-table alternatives.
Develop the deployment pipeline: Docker images for C1, C2, and C6, GitHub Actions CI, and an Azure staging environment.
Test the integrated system: integration tests for I1 to I13, role-access tests, and timing tests for the 3 s, 2 min, and 30 s budgets.
Validate and refine the C6 Forecasting Service models against the baseline using MAE, RMSE, WAPE, and forecast bias.
Document the user guide, deployment guide, and final design report, and update README.md and Design_Diagrams to match the built system.
Refine C1 and C2 by fixing defects found in T11 and applying accessibility and usability fixes before release v1.0.
Develop the C1 Web Dashboard settings and administration pages: capacity thresholds, staffing ratios, and user role management for the admin role.
